{{Quote|Eees best speeder in oh-aaay-sees. Eees ''maaarvel''.|Gloamer|<ref name="Kenobi" />}}
'''Gloamer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] who worked as a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] mechanic at [[Dannar's Claim]] in the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]], on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Gloamer ran a vibrant trade and took up the third largest portion of the garages in Dannar's Claim. Gloamer had several [[Aide/Legends|assistants]] that worked with him, including his lead assistant, a [[Vuvrian/Legends|Vuvrian]]. Gloamer also worked on the two other parts of the garages, the [[Settlers' Call Fund]] vehicle garage and [[Orrin Gault]]'s [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporator]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Gloamer was working on an [[USV-5 Modified Landspeeder|USV-5]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] and considered it the best speeder in the Pika Oasis.<ref name="Kenobi" />
